title: DNA Codec v3: Self-Descriptive Container Protocol for DNA Data Storage
description: Python implementation of a self-descriptive container protocol that encodes binary data into DNA sequences, with optional AES-256-GCM encryption and byte-level Reed-Solomon parity. Research code. Version 3.0.1 corrects the documentation to match the repository (no unsupported recovery-rate or validation claims, real API, known limitations) and aligns the license metadata to AGPL-3.0.
